Hound Partners Has Upped Its Stake in Facebook (FB) by $97.26 Million; Azimuth Capital Management Has Boosted Position in At&T (T) by $375,364 as Shares Declined
May 18, 2018 - By Henry Gaston
Jonathan Auerbach increased its stake in Facebook Inc (FB) by 82.47% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Hound Partners Llc bought 552,622 shares as the company’s stock declined 14.10% with the market. The hedge fund run by Jonathan Auerbach held 1.22 million shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $215.76M, up from 670,075 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Hound Partners Llc who had been investing in Facebook Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $529.08 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.53% or $0.98 $182.78. About 9.21M shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 8.48% uptrending. It has underperformed by 3.07% the S&P500.
Azimuth Capital Management Llc increased its stake in At&T Inc (T) by 3.36% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Azimuth Capital Management Llc bought 9,878 shares as the company’s stock declined 10.37% with the market. The institutional investor held 303,669 shares of the telecommunications equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $11.81M, up from 293,791 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Azimuth Capital Management Llc who had been investing in At&T Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $196.79B market cap company. The stock increased 0.36% or $0.11 $32.04. About 16.56M shares traded. AT&T Inc. (NYSE:T) has declined 15.88% downtrending. It has underperformed by 27.43% the S&P500.
